topics.title: OpenAI ships GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol
topics.why: The new flagship (Astra) is the first OpenAI model to trip its own "high-risk cyber capability" safety threshold, while the cheaper everyday model (Sol) just became the default assistant for millions of knowledge workers overnight.

topics.title: Nvidia's ousted CEO agrees to face the Senate
topics.why: Jensen Huang resigned after an affair scandal involving an alleged Chinese spy, and has now agreed to testify before the Senate Banking Committee — a reminder that AI's biggest hardware company just lost its founder-CEO to personal scandal, not strategy.

topics.title: Thinking Machines Lab's $5B round comes with a co-founder firing
topics.why: Mira Murati's year-old, product-less startup closed the largest AI seed round of the year, then fired co-founder/CTO Barret Zoph days later — a sign of how fast leadership can fracture inside even the best-funded AI labs.
